theory.intro: A timetable is a table of times. Each row is usually a stop or service and each column is a time, often written in 24-hour notation.
facts: Check the headings to see how the timetable is arranged. When stops are rows and services are columns, read down a column to follow one trip and across a row to see the services at one stop.
Find the cell where the right row and column meet.
To find a journey length, subtract the start time from the finish time.
steps: Check the headings and find the stop or session you want.
Find the service or time heading you need.
Read the time where they meet — convert to 12-hour if asked.

workedExamples.question_text:
Each column follows one train journey. Times use 24-hour notation.
$\begin{array}{c|cc}&\text{T1}&\text{T2}\\\hline\text{Burwood}&1440&1510\\\text{Redfern}&1525&1555\end{array}$
How long does T1 take from Burwood to Redfern?
workedExamples.solution_text:
Read down the T1 column: the train leaves Burwood at $1440$ and reaches Redfern at $1525$.
$\begin{aligned}1440\to1500&=20\text{ min}\\1500\to1525&=25\text{ min}\\20+25&=45\text{ min}\end{aligned}$
The journey takes $45\text{ min}$.

workedExamples.question_text:
Each column follows one bus journey. Times use 24-hour notation. Both buses arrive on the next day.
$\begin{array}{c|cc}&\text{B1}&\text{B2}\\\hline\text{Station}&2315&2340\\\text{Airport}&0035&0050\end{array}$
How long does B1 take from Station to Airport?
workedExamples.solution_text:
Read down the B1 column. Count from $2315$ to midnight, then from midnight to $0035$.
$\begin{aligned}2315\to2400&=45\text{ min}\\0000\to0035&=35\text{ min}\end{aligned}$
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}45+35\\&=80\text{ min}\\&=1\text{ h }20\text{ min}\end{aligned}$
The journey takes $1\text{ h }20\text{ min}$.

workedExamples.question_text:
Each column follows one train journey. A dash means the train does not stop there. Times use 24-hour notation.
$\begin{array}{c|ccc}&\text{T1}&\text{T2}&\text{T3}\\\hline\text{Croydon}&1505&\text{—}&1540\\\text{Central}&1525&1535&1600\end{array}$
Noah reaches Croydon station at $3{:}18\text{ pm}$. How long must he wait for the next train?
workedExamples.solution_text:
$3{:}18\text{ pm}$ is $1518$. T1 has already left, and T2 does not stop at Croydon. The next train is T3 at $1540$.
$1518\to1540=22\text{ min}$
Noah waits $22\text{ min}$.

workedExamples.question_text:
Each column follows one train journey. A dash means the train does not stop there. Times use 24-hour notation.
$\begin{array}{c|ccc}&\text{T1}&\text{T2}&\text{T3}\\\hline\text{Ashfield}&1510&1525&1540\\\text{Macdonaldtown}&1525&\text{—}&1555\\\text{Central}&1531&1540&1601\end{array}$
Ella wants to reach Macdonaldtown by $3{:}50\text{ pm}$. Which is the latest train she can take from Ashfield?
workedExamples.solution_text:
$3{:}50\text{ pm}$ is $1550$. T1 reaches Macdonaldtown at $1525$, before the deadline. T2 does not stop there, and T3 arrives too late at $1555$.
Ella must take **T1**, leaving Ashfield at $1510$.

foundation.question_text:
The ferry timetable is $\begin{array}{c|cc} &\text{F1}&\text{F2}\\\hline\text{Harbour}&0820&0950\\\text{Island}&0855&1025\end{array}$.
How long does F2 take from Harbour to Island?

The bus timetable is $\begin{array}{c|cc} &\text{B1}&\text{B2}\\\hline\text{Park}&0910&0945\\\text{Clinic}&0935&1010\end{array}$.
How long does B1 take from Park to Clinic?

A bus timetable shows $\begin{array}{c|cc} &\text{Route 3}&\text{Route 8}\\\hline\text{Park}&0720&0750\\\text{Library}&0745&0815\end{array}$.
Which is the latest bus from Park that reaches the Library by $8{:}20\text{ am}$?
foundation.solution_text:
Both buses reach the Library by $0820$.
Route 8 leaves later, at $0750$.
The latest bus is **Route 8**.

Buses leave the pool according to $\begin{array}{c|cc} &\text{B1}&\text{B2}\\\hline\text{Pool}&1620&1650\\\text{Station}&1635&1705\end{array}$.
Mia arrives at the pool bus stop at $4{:}12\text{ pm}$. How long does she need to wait for the next bus?
foundation.solution_text:

$1612\to1620=8\text{ min}$
Mia waits $8\text{ min}$.

development.solution_text:
